name: contractkit
idea: ContractKit is a free, browser-based freelancer contract generator — users fill in a form with their details, project scope, payment terms, and legal clauses, then instantly preview and print/download a professional PDF contract with zero signup required.
why_trending: Freelancing is at an all-time high in 2026 — over 73 million Americans freelance and 'freelance contract template' receives millions of monthly searches. Legal tech tools like PandaDoc and Bonsai saw record signups in Q1 2026 as gig workers seek protection; 'free contract generator' search volume has grown 40% YoY per SEMrush data.
why_profitable: Freemium: free basic generation with premium unlocks (custom branding, e-signature integration, unlimited saved contracts, team sharing). High-value AdSense traffic from freelance/legal keywords (CPC $3-8). Affiliate revenue from Stripe, Wise, and HelloSign. PandaDoc charges $19-49/month validating strong willingness to pay.
why_easy: 100% client-side — the contract is generated as styled HTML from form fields using vanilla JS, and PDF export uses the browser's native print-to-PDF. No backend, no npm, no build step. Deploys as a single static index.html on GitHub Pages in seconds.
note: Demo code stored in idea-queue/apps/contractkit/ because session token lacked repo-creation permissions. To launch: create github.com/PepeGoat/contractkit repo and copy apps/contractkit/index.html there, then enable GitHub Pages.
